about: What each list's match field says (`cases`) and what a program's own words say (`words`), and what the card must then show. tests/test_match_statements.py checks the Python reading (the adapters and grantmatch/match_words.py); web/test/match.test.ts checks the card's (web/src/ready.ts). One file, so the two can't drift. `call` is the line on an open call, `program` on a catalog or hand-kept program.

words.name: planning only
words.text: No match required for planning grants; implementation grants require matching funds.

words.name: year one only
words.text: No match is required in year one. Grantees must provide a 1:1 match in year two.

words.name: small awards only
words.text: No match required for awards under $5,000. Larger awards must be matched dollar for dollar.

words.name: not to apply, but at award
words.text: No match required to apply, but applicants must provide matching funds at award.

words.name: unless capital
words.text: No match required unless the project is capital construction.

words.name: fl-87527
words.text: Funds distributed from this specific appropriation must be matched by local government, federal government, or private funds. The matching ratio for allocation of these funds shall be 30 percent non-state and 70 percent state funding, other than veterans court, which shall have a matching ratio of 20 percent non-state funding and 80 percent state funding. However, no match will be required for a problem-solving court that by its primary purpose or mission addresses activities for which state dollars are typically expended. Further, if the county meets the definition of a "fiscally constrained county," as provided in section 218.67, Florida Statutes, no match will be required.

words.name: fl-87345
words.text: Deadline information can be obtained by contacting The Florida Department of Education, Office of Equity and Access at: http://www.fldoe.org/eeop/default.asp Other: The participating partner is required to match at least 1/3 of the allocation provided to the partnership in the General Appropriations Act in materials and services to the program

words.name: fl-88595
words.text: The business must provide company matches to the training program comprised of cash or in-kind contributions.

words.name: fl-88611
words.text: Obtain the commitment and involvement of private sector entities by virtue of funding matches with a ratio of 50% provided by the private sector and 50% provided by the state.

words.name: fl-88798
words.text: From funds available to the Trust and used for land acquisition, 75 percent shall be matched by local governments on a dollar for dollar basis.

words.name: fl-90605
words.text: Each award must be matched by at least 50% local funds unless the recipient is located in a fiscally constrained county.

words.name: fl-88748
words.purpose: The Department will provide the City of Miramar a fifty-percent match of their expenses up to and not to exceed $500,000.

words.name: a required match, no figure
words.text: Up to $50,000, with a required match.

words.name: people matched
words.text: Dads will be matched with a mentor. Youth must be matched with a mentor.

words.name: one to one
words.text: A 1:1 cash or in-kind match is required.
